description: The Release 0 exit proof is complete (BUILD-MAP-001 section (d), R0 exit gate): apps/server/src/core/config/release0-proof-coverage.spec.ts checks scripts/proof-admission/release0-index.json against BUILD-MAP-001 sections (b) and (c), BUILD-QUEUE-001.json tests_first and every manifest under scripts/proof-admission/manifests/: every Release 0 server suite is bound by a Release 0 manifest, no manifest names a missing suite, every skip and todo in a Release 0 suite is explained, the index names exactly the R0 packets BUILD-MAP lists, and proof:release0 and its CI step run exactly the indexed manifests. Every case is required and allowAdditionalCases is false. Run from the repo root: pnpm --filter server proof:release0 (run-manifests over every Release 0 manifest, then this spec).
